research_basis.authoring_method: Original synthesis using the user brief and the THE DMI implementation reference as the structural benchmark.

objects.key_discriminator: In AI Fundamentals, The key shift is from noticing or naming issues to using a repeatable structure for routine decisions.

common_false_positives.why_not_sufficient: The person can use the right words but cannot apply them to a real example without guidance.
A single good result may reflect luck, a template, or heavy support rather than dependable practice.

minimum_threshold_evidence: Uses a simple routine independently in at least one authentic task.
Can explain why a choice was made, not just what was done.
strong_threshold_evidence: Applies the same structure across more than one task or context.
Identifies at least one limitation or follow-up check without prompting.
objects.decision_rule: Assign the lower level when evidence is inconsistent, dependent on support, or confined to unusually favourable cases.

objects.key_discriminator: In AI Fundamentals, The key shift is from applying a tidy routine to adapting that routine when context, stakes, or evidence change.

common_false_positives.why_not_sufficient: The person follows a process well in familiar cases but cannot adjust it when conditions change.
Fast use of a tool can mask weak judgement about suitability, risk, or audience.

minimum_threshold_evidence: Adjusts criteria, workflow, or oversight in response to a changed context.
Can explain a trade-off rather than presenting one option as universally correct.
strong_threshold_evidence: Shows adaptive judgement across multiple contexts with different stakes.
Supports peers by explaining not just the decision but the conditions behind it.
objects.decision_rule: Assign the lower level when evidence is inconsistent, dependent on support, or confined to unusually favourable cases.

objects.key_discriminator: In AI Fundamentals, The key shift is from strong personal practice to shaping shared norms, resources, or system-level decisions.

common_false_positives.why_not_sufficient: An individual may be excellent personally without yet influencing wider capability or design.
People may be treated as experts because they are enthusiastic or visible, not because they shape robust practice.

minimum_threshold_evidence: Creates or revises guidance, exemplars, or shared processes used by others.
Evaluates or redesigns practice using evidence beyond a single case.
strong_threshold_evidence: Builds capacity in others through mentoring, curriculum, policy, or workflow design.
Anticipates emerging issues and adapts shared practice before failure occurs.
